description: Source code implementing GLSL to HLSL translation for uniforms and interface blocks, including resource register assignment and shader resource declarations.

classes.name: ResourcesHLSL
classes.description: Class managing resource declarations, register assignments, and resource grouping for GLSL to HLSL translation.

methods.name: reserveUniformRegisters
methods.description: Reserves uniform register space starting at specified count.

methods.name: reserveUniformBlockRegisters
methods.description: Reserves uniform block register space starting at specified count.

methods.name: findUniformByName
methods.description: Finds a uniform variable by name.

methods.name: assignUniformRegister
methods.description: Assigns a register index to a uniform based on its type and name.

methods.name: assignSamplerInStructUniformRegister
methods.description: Assigns a register for a sampler that is a field within a uniform structure.

methods.name: outputHLSLSamplerUniformGroup
methods.description: Outputs resource declarations for a group of sampler uniforms.

methods.name: outputHLSLImageUniformIndices
methods.description: Outputs uniform indices for image resources.

methods.name: outputHLSLReadonlyImageUniformGroup
methods.description: Outputs resource declarations for readonly image groups.

methods.name: outputHLSLImageUniformGroup
methods.description: Outputs resource declarations for writable image groups.

methods.name: outputHLSL4_0_FL9_3Sampler
methods.description: Outputs resource declarations for a sampler and texture in HLSL 4.0/9.3.

methods.name: outputAtomicCounterBuffer
methods.description: Outputs a declaration for an atomic counter buffer.

methods.name: uniformsHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for uniforms, grouping samplers and images as needed.

methods.name: uniformBlockString
methods.description: Generates a uniform block (constant buffer) string.

methods.name: shaderStorageBlockString
methods.description: Generates a shader storage block string.

methods.name: InterfaceBlockInstanceString
methods.description: Generates a string for an interface block instance, considering array index.

methods.name: uniformBlockMembersString
methods.description: Generates members string for a uniform block.

methods.name: uniformBlockStructString
methods.description: Generates a struct string for a uniform block.
